extensions.description: Provides agent driven UI using the A2UI JSON format.

card.description: Shows your CircleCI pipelines: recent runs by branch and commit with their outcome, each run's workflows and jobs, and why a job failed from its logs. Reruns or cancels a workflow once you confirm.
card.name: CircleCI

scopes.pipelines.read: See your projects, pipelines and their runs

skills.description: Shows recent pipeline runs across your projects: which branch and commit each ran on, whether it passed, failed or is still running, and its workflows.
examples: Did my last push pass CI?
Anything broken in CI I should look at?
Show me the recent pipeline runs
skills.name: Pipeline status

skills.description: Opens one pipeline run and shows its workflows and each workflow's jobs, with their status and how long they took.
examples: Open the latest run on main
Show me the jobs in that workflow
What ran for my last commit?
skills.name: A run's workflows and jobs

skills.description: Finds the step that failed in a job and shows what it printed: the failing command, its exit code, and the end of its log.
examples: Show me the logs of the failing job
What broke in the lint job?
What error did the tests hit?
skills.name: Why a job failed

skills.description: Reruns a workflow — every job, or only the failed ones — or cancels one that's still running, once you confirm.
skills.name: Rerunning and canceling
